description: Docker images (compose), GitHub Actions, and version variables. PRs are batched weekly to keep the noise down; the lint workflow gates every PR.

packageRules.description: Group patch/minor updates into a single weekly PR; majors stay individual

wg-easy majors stay individual and are never merged blind: 14 to 15 was a rewrite whose only import path is an HTTP call the deploy must make itself (roles/deploy/tasks/wg_easy_migrate.yml, ADR-020). The 15 hold is lifted, but a major here still means reading the release notes before merging — this container is the VPN and the only route to the offsite Pi.

Collabora majors track the LibreOffice core and are paired with a richdocuments version on the Nextcloud side; a mismatch breaks document editing while the container stays healthy. Read the release notes and check the connector before merging (ADR-021).

Uptime Kuma runs knex migrations at start and exits 1 before listening if one fails — 2.5.0 did exactly that on 2026-08-02 (fix-stat-daily-overflow, 'no such savepoint: trx6'), and since this container IS the monitoring, nothing was left to raise the alarm. Never merge it in the weekly batch: back the DB up first and follow knowledge/runbooks/uptime-kuma-migration-failure.md.
Immich pins are managed manually (one-way DB migrations, server & ML must move together — see feedback 2026-07)
